automation.forbidden: This area is outside your permissions.
automation.rulesHint: A rule is one sentence: when an event happens, if its conditions hold, then its actions run. An event produced by an automation action never triggers another rule, so rules cannot chain.
automation.ruleFormHint: A rule’s trigger, conditions and actions are fixed once it is created — changing what a rule does would rewrite the meaning of the executions already pointing at it. Its name, priority and status stay editable.
automation.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2–40 characters.
automation.name: Rule name
automation.triggerHint: Only events this platform emits can trigger a rule; anything else is refused when the rule is saved. Time-based triggers do not exist yet.
automation.conditionsEmpty: No conditions — the rule runs on every occurrence of its trigger.
automation.thresholdHint: Money metrics are minor units — 50000 means 500.00. Counts are plain counts.
automation.payloadPathHint: A dotted path into the event body, for example rewardType.
automation.payloadValueHint: Compared for equality only — never for order.
automation.actionsEmpty: A rule with no actions does nothing. Add at least one.
automation.actionsRefused: Email, LINE, AI, coach, segment, task and workflow actions have no adapter yet and are refused when the rule is saved, rather than looking configured and doing nothing.
automation.courseIdHint: The course identifier (UUID). A course retired later fails at run time, not here.
automation.executionsHint: One row per rule and event, newest first. A replayed event cannot fire the same rule twice.
automation.rewardsHint: Rewards are recognition and stay separate from money. Points and badges are handed to gamification, coupons to commerce, and everything else is a recorded grant.
automation.pointsHint: A count of points, not money.
automation.couponCurrencyHint: ISO-4217, for example THB. Left blank, the tenant currency is used.
automation.configRecorded: A recorded grant — the fulfilment happens off the platform.
automation.grantHint: A manual grant is recorded against the administrator who made it.
automation.grantsHint: Every reward this workspace has granted, newest first. A revoked grant stays on the list as revoked — the row is the history of what was given and taken back.
automation.grantsEmpty: No rewards have been granted yet.
automation.revokeConfirm: Revoke this grant? The row stays as history, and anything already fulfilled — points, a badge, an issued coupon — is not undone.

integrations.forbidden: This area is outside your permissions.
integrations.endpointsHint: A webhook is one more reader of the same event log the rest of the platform runs on. Every request is signed, an event reaches an endpoint at most once, and five failed attempts stop it rather than retrying forever. Events carrying health context are never forwarded and cannot be subscribed to.
integrations.deleteConfirm: Delete this endpoint? Its delivery log goes with it and neither can be restored. To stop deliveries but keep the log, pause it instead.
integrations.deleted: Endpoint deleted, along with {count} delivery records.
integrations.endpointFormHint: The URL must be https — a signed payload must not travel in the clear.
integrations.descriptionHint: For whoever reads this list months from now.
integrations.eventsHint: Tick each event you want. There is deliberately no “all events” option: a subscription that widened by itself when the platform added an event is one nobody agreed to.
integrations.secretWarning: This is the only time this secret will be shown. Nothing stores it in a form anybody can read back, and no route returns it. Copy it into your receiver now.
integrations.secretLost: A lost secret cannot be recovered. If it goes missing, delete this endpoint and create a new one.
integrations.deliveriesHint: Newest first, with the response code and the error text. “It did not work” is not a support answer.
integrations.retryHint: A retry makes the delivery due immediately and keeps counting attempts, so the row still says how many times this event has been thrown at this URL.
integrations.keysHint: A key authenticates a caller of the public API. Listings show a prefix only, because only a hash of the key is stored.
integrations.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? It stops working immediately and permanently, it cannot be restored, and anything still calling with it starts failing at once.
integrations.keyFormHint: The key is shown once, immediately after it is created, and never again.
integrations.keyExpiresAtHint: Optional. A key that never expires is a key nobody revisits.
integrations.scopesHint: A key can never hold a permission you do not hold yourself — otherwise minting one would be a way to promote yourself. Anything you lack is refused, and the refusal names it.
integrations.noWildcards: There are no wildcard scopes. A key lists exactly what it may do.
integrations.keyWarning: This is the only time this key will be shown. Only a hash of it is stored, so no route can return it again.
integrations.keyLost: If it is lost, revoke this key and create another.
integrations.scopeRefusedTitle: Refused — you do not hold every scope you asked for
integrations.scopeRefusedHint: These have been unticked and stay unavailable until someone grants them to you.
